findings.title: Preserve partial output when model streaming raises
findings.why_it_matters: A model transport error after a visible answer prefix bypasses the new typed answer failure contract. Replaying the compiled graph with answer_stream yielding VISIBLE_PARTIAL_ANSWER and then raising LlmUnavailableError emits that delta followed by AGENT_ERROR with stop_reason=read_error and has_partial_answer=false, losing the actual output state and diagnostics. Catching model service exceptions inside the answer generator lets synthesize retain the published prefix and report an output failure without retrying or concatenating another generation.

findings.title: Planning envelopes bypass the final answer protocol guard
findings.why_it_matters: Final answers can publish the exact calls-array envelope used by the graph planner, nested function-call JSON, or tool_use XML and still emit successful done. Both reviewers reproduced protocol text reaching the user, including one-character chunks, because the guard examines only a few top-level JSON fields and skips the rest of a decoded object; its XML openers also omit tool_use/invoke. Recognizing the actual supported planning shapes before releasing them restores bounded repair before visible text or typed failure afterward, while explicit examples and ordinary JSON stay valid.
